1.title: Troy Jackson, a Progressive Brawler, Tries to Flip a Senate Seat in Maine
1.summary: Mr. Jackson landed in the race unexpectedly. Democrats are hoping he can unseat Susan Collins, a Republican, in their bid to retake the Senate.

2.title: American Yom Kippur: How Jews Across the U.S. Observe the Holiest Day of the Year
2.summary: From 200-mile treks to synagogue to spiritual striving, readers share the rituals that define Judaism’s holiest day for them.

3.title: Abdul-El Sayed, a Democrat, Has an Unlikely Defender: Tucker Carlson
3.summary: Mr. Carlson, the far-right podcaster, has promoted Dr. El-Sayed’s comments and sharply criticized his Republican rival in a key Senate race. Strategists are scratching their heads.

4.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
4.summary: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

5.title: Inside the Breakdown of U.K.-Israel Relations Over West Bank Settlements
5.summary: British officials believed Israel had said it would hold off on moving ahead with construction in E1, a piece of land viewed as vital to a future Palestinian state. Israel said it promised no such thing.

6.title: Houthis Push to Expand Territory as Tensions With Saudi Arabia Rise
6.summary: The Iranian-backed militia was engaged in fierce battles with Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen on Sunday, as it seeks to maintain momentum in the war.
